title: IDIR
paper_title: Implicit Neural Representations for Deformable Image Registration
core_mech: IDIR 将位移场本身作为坐标神经场，并在测试图像对上直接优化，而不是由训练好的网络一次预测 flow。
core_mech_en: Parameterizes the continuous 3D deformation field φ(x) = x + u_θ(x) for a single image pair directly as a coordinate-based Implicit Neural Representation (SIREN MLP) optimized at test time.
input_desc: 一对 fixed/moving 图像及在图像域采样的连续坐标 x
input_en: Continuous 3D spatial coordinates x ∈ [-1,1]³ sampled over a fixed/moving volume pair (I_f, I_m)
output_desc: 可在任意坐标查询的连续位移场 uθ(x) 和 warped moving 图像
output_en: Resolution-independent continuous deformation field φ_θ(x) with exact autograd spatial derivatives

adapter.name: IDIR
adapter.mechanism: A SIREN coordinate network fits one image pair's displacement at test time with autograd spatial derivatives.
limitations: Only the first synthetic pair is fitted; smoothness regularization rather than every original Jacobian/bending variant; normalized coordinates.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
